paragraphs: Sensoneo sells end-to-end solutions for data-driven waste management and a digitalised circular economy. Its ultrasonic bin sensor product line is offered to get control of waste fill-levels in bins, dumpsters and containers. The listed ultrasonic types are Single Sensor 5.0, Single Sensor 3.0 and Quatro Sensor, with connectivity over LoRaWAN, Sigfox, NB-IoT and CAT-M1.

A radar sensor covers liquid waste fill-level monitoring in fluid tanks. The Route Planning solution automates and optimizes the management of waste collection routes. The homepage attributes optimized collection frequency to an installation of sensors in the City of Prague.

A separate product is the DRS IT System, built for Deposit Return Schemes that the pages say are usually operated by governments. Its modules are described around producers, importers, retailers and logistics providers.

quote.text: Monitoring any type of waste in any type of bins
